title: Canonical units and restrictions of the relative Mayer--Vietoris sequence
statement: Let f:X→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Write L and R for derived pullback and direct image on the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Use the derived adjunctions pinned to the left-derived counits and right-derived units [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], and the pinned pullback composition comparisons [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. For j:A→X define C(j,f):Rj⋙Rf≅R(j≫f) as the unique right-adjoint comparison obtained from the pullback comparison and these adjunctions. Define the relative unit u(j,f,K)=Rf(ηj(K)) followed by C(j,f). For k:B→A and l:B→X with k≫j=l, let c:Lj⋙Lk≅Ll be pullback composition followed by equality transport. Define b:RjLjK→RlLlK as the adjoint under Ll⊣Rl of c⁻¹(RjLjK) followed by Lk(εj(LjK)) followed by c(K). The relative restriction ρ(k,j,l,f,K) is C(j,f)⁻¹ followed by Rf(b) followed by C(l,f). The first two sequence maps are the biproduct lift of the U,V units and the biproduct desc of the U restriction and negative V restriction. After a functor F, map the individual units and restrictions before taking the lift and desc. For an inverse-image cover, inclusions between the chosen pullback schemes are the unique pullback lifts with first projection unchanged and second projection followed by X.homOfLE. The local and global comparison arrows are exactly the canonical base-change maps [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by the specified restriction of the object map, with the two pinned pullback comparisons and equality transport.

def relativeMVRestriction {B A X S : Scheme.{u}} (k : B ⟶ A) (j : A ⟶ X)
    (l : B ⟶ X) (h : k ≫ j = l) (f : X ⟶ S) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage (j ≫ f)).obj ((derivedPullback j).obj K) ⟶
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (l ≫ f)).obj ((derivedPullback l).obj K)
